metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Millington's book, the garden, the parliament sheet, and John's bag.

yesterday: The book has Pembroke's name. Drayton asked, and you answered the four sentences. On the walk up you asked whose the plays are.
You added a few lines to the garden and headed the parliament sheet.
The Rose's bill for today is marked paid. It is the Revels' fee.
Last Saturday was 36s. John left the bag open.
